# Introduction (sample)

This placeholder chapter proves the Quarto book build works. Real chapters
will arrive after a LaTeX→Quarto conversion pass (see the preface).

## Semaphores in one sentence

A **semaphore** is a synchronization variable that supports `wait` and
`signal` (or `P`/`V`), used to coordinate threads without busy-waiting.

## Interactive Sync (mutex)

The div below is authoring syntax for Task 23. Quarto’s Lua filter turns it
into a Sync mount point; `sync_embed.js` loads Pyodide and runs
`mutex.py` from the book assets.

::: {.sync example="mutex.py"}
:::

Authoring rule: one `example="…"` (a file under `assets/sync/examples/`)
per embed. Use `file=` as an alias for `example=`.
